questions.questionText: Which existing enterprise capabilities can be reused by this solution?
How does the solution align to current shared service standards?
What IAM model (SSO, MFA, RBAC) is required for this solution?
Which mandatory security controls must be implemented at go-live?
Which commercial SaaS products currently satisfy at least 80% of core requirements?
What required capabilities are unavailable in current SaaS offerings?
What constraints (regulatory, sovereignty, tenancy, integration) block SaaS adoption?
If custom build is proposed, what differentiating capability justifies it over SaaS?
How do implementation timeline and total cost compare between SaaS and custom build options?
Does the use case require advanced CRM and case management capabilities at scale?
What customer engagement and case lifecycle features are mandatory at launch?
How much of the workload is service workflow, ITSM, or internal operations process automation?
Is rapid low-code app delivery by business teams a primary requirement?
Which enterprise systems (EMPI, registries, identity, finance) require bi-directional integration?
What integration volume, latency, and reliability targets must the platform sustain?
How important are vendor ecosystem depth, certified partners, and governance tooling?
Do internal teams have the skills and capacity to operate the selected platform 24x7?
What managed services or partner support model is required for steady-state operations?
Which compliance controls (privacy, audit, retention) are mandatory for platform approval?
Based on evidence, which platform best satisfies CRM/case, integration, and governance requirements?
What are the top risks, alternatives, and confidence score for the selected platform?
